build_tracker_head: build a tracker head from a detectron2 CfgNode config by resolving TRACKER_NAME from the TRACKER_HEADS registry
create_base_tracker: create a BaseTracker instance to manage per-object ID assignment across video frames
register_tracker_head: register a custom tracker class with the TRACKER_HEADS_REGISTRY for detectron2 tracking
update_tracker_instances: update tracker predictions by matching current frame instances to previous frame IDs
configure_tracker_from_config: configure a tracker head by calling from_config with a detectron2 CfgNode configuration
